chapter: With Benny Goodman and Louis Armstrong
title: Reconciling with Louis on his birthday
summary: Simmons gave Armstrong marijuana for his birthday; Louis wrote jokes at night.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Now, by this time, Lucille has joined the band. We get to Minneapolis and he has a birthday, the 4th of July. I had a pound cake box, tin, full of marijuana. And Louis called it 'spiscondi.' Where he got that name from I don't know. So I went by his room and knock on the door to give him a couple of spiscondis. He never worked with it. He'd wait until he got off and get with his typewriter and hunt and peck jokes. When he'd write someone a letter, that would be his letter. He'd send them a joke. You know. And he had a joke book. Now, I don't know when it's going to be published or what, but that's what he would do. Write jokes every night. Get off of work, put some salve on his lips, handkerchief on his head, visor, it's funny looking.
